sections.heading: History
sections.text:
While attending Lok sat behind Sophie in history the year that the series begins. The year before that he sat behind her in math, and the year before in science. She never noticed him in either of the three classes. Lok followed her out of the school to ask for her help on an upcoming test. Sophie immediately refused before making a bet that if he could solve her crossword puzzle in less than two minutes then she would help. [A Seeker is Born] Dante picked up Lok and Sophie after completing their history exam and completing their school year. [The Casterwill Client]

After the fall of the Professor, Lok and Sophie were scheduled to return to the Academy the next day, having effectively missed their summer vacation while on missions for the Huntik Foundation. [The Mission]

Following a history class in which Lok had fallen asleep, he and Sophie were contacted by Dante to meet him at the airport. [Doorway to Huntik] Following the re-emergence of the Organization under Wilder, they were forced to stop attending the school and began receiving home tuition by LeBlanche. [Cave of the Casterwills]

'''Venice Preparatory Academy''' is a prestigious private school established in an ancient abbey in [[Venice, Italy]]. It is the school that [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]] both attended along with their rival, [[Ford]].

== History ==
While attending Lok sat behind Sophie in history the year that the series begins. The year before that he sat behind her in math, and the year before in science. She never noticed him in either of the three classes. Lok followed her out of the school to ask for her help on an upcoming test. Sophie immediately refused before making a bet that if he could solve her crossword puzzle in less than two minutes then she would help. {{source|A Seeker is Born}} Dante picked up Lok and Sophie after completing their history exam and completing their school year. {{source|The Casterwill Client}}

After the fall of [[Simon Judeau|the Professor]], Lok and Sophie were scheduled to return to the Academy the next day, having effectively missed their summer vacation while on missions for the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|The Mission}}

Following a history class in which Lok had fallen asleep, he and Sophie were contacted by Dante to meet him at the airport. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} Following the re-emergence of [[the Organization]] under [[Wilder]], they were forced to stop attending the school and began receiving home tuition by [[LeBlanche]]. {{source|Cave of the Casterwills}}
